items.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
items.raw_content: Using agent teams and formal verification to improve quantum algorithms for fusion and chemistry.

items.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
items.raw_content: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

items.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
items.raw_content: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT-6 Luna for their conversations.

items.title: Working with AI
items.raw_content: Economics Nov 23, 2026 Working with AI We interviewed people at 58 companies that use Claude about how AI is changing their work. They described few layoffs but reduced hiring, and said the most valuable uses of AI often involved reorganizing roles and workplaces around it.

items.title: X Square Robot Introduces WALL-OSS-1.0 With a Planning Harness and API
items.title_zh: 自变量机器人发布 WALL-OSS-1.0，附带规划框架与 API
items.raw_content: X Square Robot claims zero-shot results on 312 robot tasks and is offering the XR Harness planning tool and API; its public Lite checkpoints cover a narrower evaluation.

items.title: As Apple works on AI agent features, banks are already blocking them
items.title_zh: 苹果推进 AI 智能体功能之际，银行已开始封堵
items.raw_content: Banks are already blocking AI agents that use iPhone and Mac apps to act for users, even as Apple works to turn Siri into an agent, and the article suggests this may be only the start.

items.title: NariQ: BF16-level Qwen3.8-27B in a 10 GB file
items.title_zh: NariQ：把 Qwen3.8-27B 装进 10GB 文件，保持接近 BF16 的水平
items.raw_content: NariQ offers 3-bit-or-lower quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B that its authors say retain near-BF16 quality on agentic tasks, math, multilingual reasoning and image understanding, with decode speed comparable to other quants on an RTX PRO 6000. Running them requires the team's llama.cpp fork.
